text:
I'm sorry your plant arrived damaged. A snapped main stem counts as damaged on arrival, so you're covered if you report it within **48 hours** of delivery. Please send photos of the plant and the box.

Once reported, you can choose a free replacement on the next plant shipping day or a refund. You don't need to send the plant back.

If it's been more than 48 hours since delivery, the claim goes through the Plant Care Guarantee instead (30 days from delivery, or 90 days for Leafy Plus members). That needs at least two photos, whole plant and close-up, submitted from "My Orders", and a specialist reviews it within 2 business days.
